meta.measured: 2026-07-27, DuckDB 1.5.5 vs the engine (rust regex 1.13 behind retrans.rs), tests/test_duckdb_regexp_fuzz.py grammar
meta.method: random grammar-biased patterns run through regexp_matches/full_match/extract/replace on both engines over the divergence-prone subject rows; every class below reproduced from a concrete generated case, then re-swept to zero divergences (40k cases, 8 seeds) after the fix
meta.contract: identical rows OR engine build-time reject OR both error; duck-errors-engine-serves and value mismatches are failures

findings.duckdb: Invalid Input Error: invalid escape sequence: \1 (RE2 has no backrefs)
findings.rust_regex: octal(true) — pinned for in-class octal parity — reads \1 as an octal escape and SERVES
findings.decision: reject at bind ('backreference-style \N escape'); in-class \1 stays served (octal in both)

findings.construct: stacked quantifiers, full grammar (not just */+ pairs)
findings.duckdb: Invalid Input Error: bad repetition operator (one lazy '?' is the only legal follower of a quantifier)
findings.decision: reject: after a quantifier and optional single lazy '?', any further * + ? or strict {bounds} is an error

findings.construct: nested counted repetition, bound product over 1000
findings.duckdb: Invalid Input Error: invalid repetition size: {1,999}
findings.rust_regex: no product cap at these sizes — serves
findings.decision: reject when nested {m,n} bound products exceed 1000; unbounded inner {n,} counts as over-cap (conservative: '(a{2,}){3}' rejects)

findings.rust_regex: parses it as the 1..3 repetition and replaces ('123def') — silent wrong answer
findings.decision: reject '{...}' bodies that are strict bounds after whitespace stripping but contain whitespace

findings.duckdb: literals / ranges ('[--٠]' = range '-'..'٠'; backwards ones error 'invalid character class range: h--')
findings.rust_regex: class set operations (difference/intersection/symmetric difference) — silent wrong answers measured both directions
findings.decision: reject any doubled '-' '&' '~' inside a class

findings.rust_regex: opens a NESTED class — silent wrong answers
findings.decision: reject '[' inside a class unless it starts a '[:name:]' POSIX element

findings.construct: POSIX element desyncing the class tracker
findings.rust_regex: same semantics once the element is consumed atomically
findings.decision: FIX (not reject): consume '[:...:]' atomically; '[[:alpha:]\d]' now translates to '[[:alpha:]0-9]'

findings.construct: Perl class as a range endpoint inside a class
findings.duckdb: Invalid Input Error: invalid escape sequence / invalid character class range
findings.rust_regex: the in-class expansion can COMPILE (e.g. '[\x08-\t\n..]') and serve
findings.decision: reject a Perl class escape adjacent to an unescaped range '-' on either side; trailing literal '-' ('[\d-]') stays fine

findings.construct: range starting at the class-leading literal ']'
findings.duckdb: ']-Z' parses as a RANGE (backwards ones error: 'invalid character class range: ]-Z')
findings.rust_regex: treats the '-' as literal and serves; forward ranges ('[]-a]') would silently disagree on membership
findings.decision: reject '-' directly after the class-leading ']' unless immediately before ']' ('[]-]' stays fine)

findings.witness: regexp_matches(s, '$\z(?i)') over __THIS__ vs as a constant
findings.duckdb: SELF-INCONSISTENT (measured): row path FALSE for 'hello world' / TRUE only for '' (literal-comparison optimization); constant fold TRUE everywhere. 'd$\z', '($\z)', 'x|$\z', '^()^' are all rescued and consistent
findings.rust_regex: matches the empty string at the anchors (agrees with duckdb's constant fold only)
findings.decision: reject patterns consisting only of ^ $ \A \z, \b, flag groups, and empty '(?:)' when they contain 2+ text anchors — unservable either way

findings.construct: capture group under an exactly-zero repetition
findings.duckdb: keeps the group in the count: \1 in range, non-participating -> '' ; replaces (' ' -> '$1-')
findings.rust_regex: erases the group from the compiled regex — the rewrite's MaxSubmatch pre-check sees 0 groups and no-ops; later group numbers would shift too
findings.decision: reject a capturing group followed by {0}/{0,0}; '(?:a){0}' and 'a{0}' stay fine

findings.construct: rewrite template: out-of-range backref AFTER a bad escape
findings.duckdb: input UNCHANGED — RE2's MaxSubmatch pre-check scans the whole template first, out-of-range wins over the global bad-escape consume quirk
findings.rust_regex: n/a (bind-time template translation ordered the checks left-to-right)
findings.decision: FIX: translate_rewrite pre-scans the whole template for out-of-range \N before the bad-escape scan

findings.witness: regexp_replace over 'héllo ٣٤' produced invalid UTF-8 (pyarrow decode failure on the ORACLE side)
findings.duckdb: serves raw bytes that can split multibyte chars
findings.rust_regex: does not support \C — engine build-rejects via the compile error
findings.decision: no change (already an identical-reject); fuzzer harness treats undecodable duckdb output as a duckdb error
